questions.question: If x² + (4 - √3)x - 1 = 0, then what is the value of x²+(1)/(x²)?
If (4y-(4)/(y))=11, find the value of (y²+(1)/(y²)).
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Given, 4(y − 1/y) = 11 ⇒ y − 1/y = 11/4

Direct formula: If x − 1/x = a, then x² + 1/x² = a² + 2

⇒ y² + 1/y² = (11/4)² + 2

⇒ y² + 1/y² = 121/16 + 2 = 153/16

⇒ 153/16 = 9 ⁹/₁₆

**∴ The correct answer is 9 ⁹/₁₆.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

4y − 4/y = 11

**Formula Used:**

(a − b)² = a² + b² − 2ab

**Calculations:**

⇒ 4(y − 1/y) = 11

⇒ y − 1/y = 11/4

Squaring both sides:

⇒ (y − 1/y)² = (11/4)²

⇒ y² + 1/y² − 2 × y × (1/y) = 121/16

⇒ y² + 1/y² − 2 = 121/16

⇒ y² + 1/y² = 121/16 + 2

⇒ y² + 1/y² = (121 + 32) / 16

⇒ y² + 1/y² = 153/16 = 9 ⁹/₁₆

**∴ The correct answer is 9 ⁹/₁₆.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Algebraic Identities for Squares

If x + 1/x = a, then x² + 1/x² = a² − 2

Algebraic Identities for Cubes

If x + 1/x = a, then x³ + 1/x³ = a³ − 3a

Difference to Sum Conversion

If x − 1/x = a, then x + 1/x = √(a² + 4)

questions.question: If x(5-(2)/(x)) = (5)/(x) , then the value of x² +(1)/(x²) is:
If 8a³ + b³ + 27c³ = 18 abc, then the relation among a, b and c is:
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Standard Identity: If x³ + y³ + z³ = 3xyz, then x + y + z = 0.

Given equation: 8a³ + b³ + 27c³ = 18abc

Rewrite as: (2a)³ + (b)³ + (3c)³ = 3 × (2a) × (b) × (3c)

Here x = 2a, y = b, and z = 3c.

⇒ 2a + b + 3c = 0 ⇒ b + 3c = −2a

**∴ The correct answer is b + 3c = −2a.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

8a³ + b³ + 27c³ = 18abc

**Formula Used:**

x³ + y³ + z³ − 3xyz = (x + y + z)(x² + y² + z² − xy − yz − zx)

If x³ + y³ + z³ = 3xyz, then either x + y + z = 0 or x = y = z.

**Calculations:**

⇒ The given expression can be arranged as follows by bringing all terms to one side:

⇒ 8a³ + b³ + 27c³ − 18abc = 0

⇒ Now, represent each term as a perfect cube:

⇒ (2a)³ + (b)³ + (3c)³ − 3 × (2a) × (b) × (3c) = 0

⇒ Comparing this directly with the algebraic identity, we can substitute x = 2a, y = b, and z = 3c.

⇒ According to the identity rule, for the expression to be zero, the sum of the base variables must be zero.

⇒ x + y + z = 0

⇒ 2a + b + 3c = 0

⇒ Moving 2a to the right side of the equation:

⇒ b + 3c = −2a

This strictly matches the relation given in the options.

**∴ The correct answer is b + 3c = −2a.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Core Algebraic Identity

a³ + b³ + c³ − 3abc = (a + b + c)(a² + b² + c² − ab − bc − ca).

Conditional Cubes Identity

If a + b + c = 0, then substituting this into the main identity simplifies to a³ + b³ + c³ = 3abc.

Sum of Squares Form

a² + b² + c² − ab − bc − ca = ½[(a − b)² + (b − c)² + (c − a)²].

Equality Condition

If a³ + b³ + c³ = 3abc and a + b + c ≠ 0, it strictly means a = b = c.
</p

questions.question: If x + y + z = 7, x² + y² + z² = 85 and x³ + y³ + z³ = 913, then the value of sqrt[3]{xyz} is
questions.solution:
**Given:**

x + y + z = 7

x2 + y2 + z2 = 85

x3 + y3 + z3 = 913

**Formula used:**

x³ + y³ + z³ – 3xyz = (x + y + z) (x² + y² + z² – (xy + yz + zx)) .....(1)

(x + y + z)² = x² + y² + z² + 2(xy + yz + zx) ....(2)

**Calculation:**

⇒ 7² = 85 + 2(xy + yz + zx)

⇒ 49 – 85 = 2(xy + yz + zx)

⇒ -36 = 2(xy + yz + zx)

⇒ (xy + yz + zx) = -36/2

⇒ (xy + yz + zx) =-18

⇒ 913 – 3xyz = 7(85 + 18)

⇒ 913 – 7 × 103 = 3xyz

⇒ 913 – 721 = 3xyz

⇒ 192 = 3xyz

⇒ 64 = xyz

⇒ (4)³ = sqrt[3]{xyz}

**∴ The value of sqrt[3]{xyz} is 4**

questions.question: The cube of the difference between two given natural numbers is 1728, while the product of these two given numbers is 108. Find the positive difference between the cubes of these two given numbers.

2nd natural number = B

(A - B)³ = 1728

A³ - B³ = (A - B)³ + 3AB × (A - B)

⇒ 1728 + 3 × 108 × 12

⇒ 1728 + 3 × 108 × 12

⇒ 1728 + 3888 = 5616

questions.question: The difference between two number is 3 and the difference between their cubes is 999. Find the difference between their squares.
questions.solution:
**Given-**

Difference between two numbers = 3

The difference between their cubes is 999

**Formula Used-**

x³ - y³ = (x - y)³ + 3xy(x - y)

(x + y)² = (x - y)² + 4xy

x² - y² = (x + y)(x - y)

**Calculation-**

Let the two numbers be x and y

According to Question-

x - y = 3 -------(i)

x3 - y3 = 999 -------------(ii)

⇒ (x - y)3 + 3xy(x - y) = 999

⇒ 27 + 9xy = 999

⇒ xy = 108

Now,

(x + y)2 = (x - y)2 + 4xy

⇒ (x + y)² = 9 + 432

⇒ x + y = 21

x2 - y2 = (x + y)(x - y)

⇒ x2 - y2 = 21 × 3

⇒ 63

∴ Difference between their squares = 63

If a, b and c are positive integers such that a² + b² = 82 and b² + c² = 65, then the value of 2a + 7b - 3c is:
questions.solution:
**GIVEN:**

a² + b² = 82 

b² + c² = 65 

**FORMULA USED:**

a² - b² = ( a - b) ( a + b) 

**CALCULATION :**

Here we have 

a² + b² = 82 ...............( 1) 

b² + c² = 65................(2)

Subtracting eq(1) - eq(2),we get 

⇒ a² - c² = 17 

⇒ ( a + c) ( a - c) = 17 × 1 [a² - b² = ( a + b) ( a - b) ] 

⇒ a + c = 17 ...............(3)

⇒ a - c = 1..................(4)

On adding eq(3) + eq(4), we get 

⇒ 2a = 18 ⇔ a = 9 

Now, a + c = 17 

⇒ 9 + c = 17 

⇒ c = 8 

Now, put the value of a = 9 in eq (1) we get 

⇒ 9² + b² = 82 

⇒ b² = 82 - 81 

⇒ b = 1 

Now, 2a + 7b - 3c = 2 × 9 + 7 × 1 - 3 × 8 = 1

**Hence, the required value is 1 .**

questions.question: If x + 1/x = 2√10, where x > 1, then the value of (x³ - 1/x³) is:
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

If x + 1/x = p, then x − 1/x = √(p² − 4).

Given p = 2√10, so x − 1/x = √(40 − 4) = √36 = 6.

If x − 1/x = k, then x³ − 1/x³ = k³ + 3k.

Substituting k = 6:

x³ − 1/x³ = 6³ + 3 × 6 = 216 + 18 = 234.

**∴ The correct answer is 234.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

x + 1/x = 2√10, where x > 1

**Formula Used:**

(x − 1/x)² = (x + 1/x)² − 4

x³ − 1/x³ = (x − 1/x)³ + 3(x − 1/x)

**Calculations:**

⇒ (x − 1/x)² = (2√10)² − 4

⇒ (x − 1/x)² = 4 × 10 − 4

⇒ (x − 1/x)² = 40 − 4 = 36

⇒ Since x > 1, x − 1/x will be positive. So, x − 1/x = √36 = 6

⇒ Now, substitute this into the cube formula:

⇒ x³ − 1/x³ = (6)³ + 3 × 6

⇒ x³ − 1/x³ = 216 + 18

⇒ x³ − 1/x³ = 234

**∴ The correct answer is 234.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Square Rule

If x + 1/x = a, then x² + 1/x² = a² − 2.

Cube Rule (Plus)

If x + 1/x = a, then x³ + 1/x³ = a³ − 3a.

Sign Conversion Rule

If x + 1/x = a, then x − 1/x = √(a² − 4). Similarly, if x − 1/x = a, then x + 1/x = √(a² + 4).

a + b + c = 10

**Formula used:**

x3 + y3 + z3 - 3xyz = (x + y + z){x2 + y2 + z2 - (xy + yz + xz)}

⇒ {a2 + b2 + c2 - (ab + bc + ca)} = 25 ----(i)

a + b + c = 10

⇒ (a + b + c)² = 100

⇒ a2 + b2 + c2 + 2ab + 2bc + 2ca = 100 ----(ii)

By doing (ii) – (i) we get

3ab + 3bc + 3ca = 75

⇒ ab + bc + ca = 25

(1)/(5)(ab+bc+ca)

⇒ 1/5 × 25

⇒ 5

**∴ The value of (1)/(5)(ab+bc+ca) will be 5**

So, (1)/(5)(ab+bc+ca) = 1/5(25 + 0 + 0)

questions.question: If x + y + z = 18, xyz = 81 and xy + yz + zx = 90, then find the value of sqrt[4]{x³+y³+z³+xyz} .
questions.solution:
**Given:**

x + y + z = 18, xyz = 81 and xy + yz + zx = 90

**Formula used:**

x3 + y3 + z3 - 3xyz = (x + y + z) [(x + y + z)2 - 3 (xy + yz + zx)]

**Calculation:**

x³ + y³ + z³ - 3xyz = (x + y + z) [(x + y + z)² - 3 (xy + yz + zx)]

⇒ x3 + y3 + z3 - (3 × 81) = 18 [18² - (3 × 90)]

⇒ x3 + y3 + z3 - 243 = 18 (324 - 270)

⇒ x3 + y3 + z3 - 243 = 18 × 54

⇒ x3 + y3 + z3 = 972 + 243 = 1215

⇒ x3 + y3 + z3 + xyz = 1215 + 81 = 1296

⇒ x3 + y3 + z3 + xyz = 6⁴

⇒ sqrt[4]{x³+y³+z³+xyz} = 6

**∴ The value of sqrt[4]{x³+y³+z³+xyz} is 6**

questions.question: If ( x + (2)/(x) ) = 7, then what is the value of ( 2x² + (8)/(x²) ) ?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

⇒ (x + 2/x) = 7

**Formula:**

(a + b)² = a² + b² + 2ab

**Calculation:**

According to the question,

⇒(x + 2/x) = 7

Squaring on both sides of the equation, we get

⇒(x + 2/x)2 = 7²

Using the formula: (a + b)2 = a2 + b2 + 2ab

⇒ x2 + 4/x2 + 2 × x × 2/x = 49

⇒x² + 4/x² + 4 = 49

⇒ x² + 4/x² = 49 - 4

⇒ x2 + 4/x2 = 45 

Multiplying by 2 on both sides of the equation, we get

⇒ 2 × (x2 + 4/x²) = 45 × 2

⇒ 2x² + 8/x² = 90

**∴ The value of (2x² + 8/x²) is 90.**
